integrity: The exact root-of-unity proof establishes the infinite claim. An independent finite implementation tests 29,098 parameter-modulus pairs; finite checks are not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for gap residue counts of semigroups generated by three consecutive integers with n>=3, m>=2. It does not cover factorization lengths or longer intervals. Priority against unknown literature is unverified.
title: Exact gap-residue equidistribution for three consecutive numerical-semigroup generators
